name: send_telegram_file
description: Sends a file of the PC (a PDF, a photo, a document…) to the user's phone through their own Telegram bot. Find it first with find_files and give its full path (its folder and its name). For a text message use send_telegram; never open the Telegram app or website for this.
examples: mándame al Telegram el PDF de la factura
envíame al móvil la última foto que descargué
pásame por Telegram el documento de la reunión
send the invoice PDF to my Telegram

path.description: The full path of the file, e.g. D:\Downloads\factura.pdf

caption.description: A short text to go with it (optional)

say.ok: Te he mandado el archivo al Telegram.
say.error: No he podido mandar el archivo al Telegram.
